name: Hidden Potential
description: Damage dealt by this unit builds Insight. Spend %cost% of it on an ally within %cast_range% tiles to permanently upgrade one of their abilities.
details: One Insight per instance of damage this unit deals - a swing, a tick of acid, anything traced back to it.
The cast opens a list of the target's abilities, and whichever is chosen is upgraded for the rest of the match.
This unit is a legal target for its own brew, and there is no limit on how many of one unit's abilities may be unlocked.
Each ability can be upgraded only once, and abilities with nothing written for them - a summon's own kit, an effect - never appear in the list.

upgrade.summary: Every ability unlocked is worth %stat_bonus% to each of this unit's attributes and %hp_bonus% health.
details: Every ability this unit has ever unlocked grants it %stat_bonus% strength, agility and intelligence, and %hp_bonus% maximum and current health.
It counts backwards as well as forwards: unlocks granted before this one are paid out in full the moment it lands.
This is the one ability that may be unlocked more than once. Doing so grants nothing beyond another mark on the tally, which is itself worth another %stat_bonus% and %hp_bonus%.
